description: Source file implementing quantization and dequantization functions for tensors, including checks for tensor types, device consistency, and size, as well as dispatching to specific kernel stubs for different quantization schemes.

methods.name: checkRoundingMode
methods.description: Checks or sets the rounding mode; currently disabled with a comment.

methods.name: checkFloatTensor
methods.description: Verifies that the tensor is of float type.

methods.name: checkSameDevice
methods.description: Ensures two tensors are on the same device.

methods.name: checkQuantizedTensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is quantized and of the expected type.

methods.name: checkZeroPoint
methods.description: Validates that zero point is within the valid range for type T.

methods.name: checkZeroPoints
methods.description: Checks each zero point in a tensor for validity.

methods.name: checkSameSize
methods.description: Ensures two tensors have the same shape.

methods.name: checkPerChannelParamsSize
methods.description: Validates that scales and zero points match the channel dimension.

methods.name: quantize_tensor_per_tensor_affine
methods.description: Quantizes a float tensor to a quantized tensor using per-tensor affine parameters.

methods.name: quantize_tensor_per_channel_affine
methods.description: Quantizes a float tensor to a quantized tensor using per-channel affine parameters.

methods.name: quantize_tensor_per_channel_float_qparams
methods.description: Quantizes a float tensor using per-channel float quantization parameters.

methods.name: dequantize_tensor_per_tensor_affine
methods.description: Dequantizes a quantized tensor to float using per-tensor affine parameters.

methods.name: dequantize_tensor_per_channel_affine
methods.description: Dequantizes a quantized tensor to float using per-channel affine parameters.

methods.name: dequantize_tensor_per_channel_float_qparams
methods.description: Dequantizes a quantized tensor to float using per-channel float qparams.
